syntax.syntax_item: [x, fval, exitflag, output, grad, hessian] = fminunc(___)

param_input_item.param_description: Objective function returning a real scalar. With gradient options enabled, it can also return the gradient and Hessian.
Initial scalar, vector or matrix point.
Options created with optimoptions or optimset.
Structure with fields objective, x0, solver and options.

param_output_item.param_description: Diagnostic structure with iterations, funcCount, stepsize, algorithm, firstorderopt and message.
Approximate or user supplied Hessian at x.

description.p: fminunc minimizes a scalar nonlinear objective without constraints.

The default quasi-newton algorithm uses BFGS, DFP, steepest descent, or limited-memory BFGS depending on HessianApproximation and legacy HessUpdate options. The trust-region algorithm uses user gradients, optional objective Hessians, Hessian multiply functions and truncated conjugate gradients.
Accepted display modes are off, none, final, final-detailed, notify, notify-detailed, iter and iter-detailed.
